limits: A single rank correlation can hide local shape.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI.

the_cleanest_statement_yet.reading: in the both-unseen pool drug identity carries essentially zero rank information about delta EMAX (rho -0.0015). The pathway annotation lifts it to 0.128, and a matched random block leaves it at 0.002.
the_cleanest_statement_yet.why_it_is_cleaner: the hit-rate numbers are threshold artifacts to some degree, but a rank correlation over the whole evaluation set is not. This is the plainest form of the finding so far.

it_corrects_my_R133_reasoning.what_I_said_in_R133: the gain grows as the threshold loosens, therefore the annotation improves the whole ranking rather than the tail

what_R134_shows.reading: the gain is flat across prediction-set sizes, not increasing

it_corrects_my_R133_reasoning.so: the conclusion survives but the reasoning was partly wrong: the monotone increase in R133 was mostly the hit-rate metric drifting toward tau, which is exactly the hole the protocol flagged. The global rank correlation is the evidence, not the growth pattern.
it_corrects_my_R133_reasoning.corrected_statement: annotation improves the whole ranking; the improvement is broad and roughly constant, not increasing with the cut

what_this_adds_to_the_frozen_claim.a_seventh_check: global rank correlation, which depends on no threshold at all
what_this_adds_to_the_frozen_claim.identity_is_the_control_that_matters: identity scoring -0.0015 shows the pool really is one where identity carries no signal, which is the premise the whole claim rests on

the_degeneracy_is_the_headline.reading: in 65 of 200 splits the identity score is a constant, because both drugs are held out and every identity column for the evaluation keys is zero, so the prediction collapses to the training mean. A rank correlation is undefined there. In the 135 remaining splits the mean absolute rank correlation is 1.8 percent, i.e. noise.
the_degeneracy_is_the_headline.why_it_matters: this is the strongest available form of the premise the frozen claim rests on: identity does not merely perform badly in this pool, it produces a constant. Adding the pathway block removes the degeneracy entirely - zero of 200 splits are constant - and gives a rank correlation of 0.128.

caveat_on_power: the paired rank-correlation contrast rests on 135 of 200 splits, since 65 are undefined for identity. The hit-rate contrasts, which do not require a defined rank correlation, use all 200 and agree in sign and significance, so the conclusion does not depend on the reduced sample.
